input: Research pickling and preserving techniques for summer veg

gold.taskTitle: Research Pickling and Preserving Summer Vegetables
gold.taskDescription: Research pickling and preserving techniques specifically suited to summer vegetables.

questions.title: Which specific summer vegetables do you want to preserve?
questions.description: Identify the exact vegetables the user has in mind, such as courgettes, cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, or green beans.

questions.title: What preservation methods are you interested in exploring?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to focus on one method, such as water-bath canning, fermentation, or quick pickling, or research several.

questions.title: Is this for personal consumption or gifting to others?
questions.description: Understand the end purpose, as gifting may require more attention to shelf stability, labelling, and presentation.

questions.title: How much produce are you expecting to work with?
questions.description: Clarify the scale, whether it is a few jars from a home garden harvest or larger batches from a market or allotment.

questions.title: What equipment do you currently have available at home?
questions.description: Find out whether the user has mason jars, a large stockpot, a fermentation crock, or any specialist canning equipment already.

questions.title: Do you have any dietary or flavour preferences to factor in?
questions.description: Establish whether the user wants low-sugar, low-salt, spicy, or particular flavour profiles such as dill, garlic, or sweet pickling brines.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having this research completed?
questions.description: Determine how urgently the user needs the research done, particularly whether they have a harvest window or seasonal deadline approaching.
